description: A stubby chip in a hard grey caddy, its contact edge dulled by however many hands have turned it over. The label is a printed sticker stuck over another printed sticker. It writes SPECTER to the tablet's ROM once and then burns itself out, which the seller will tell you is a security feature.
name: SPECTER Install Chip
